For dies using acidic lubricants and wire of high tensile strength 6. General Requirements

having tensile

6.1 The pellet shall be positively and permanently fixed in its correct position in the case. The method of fixing shall be such that adequate support is provided to the peripheral face and the base of the pellet. 6.2 All surfaces of the pellet bore shall be free from scratches naturally inherent in the finishing process. - The sampling and criteria 7. Sampling ` Methods for sampling small tools `. 8. Designation - Shall be designated diameter of pellet, diameter of case, standard. Example 1: of acceptance shall and irregularities, be in accordance other than those with IS: 7778-1975

by the name, code-letter of die, code-letter of shape of case, diameter of bearing, drawing angle and the number of this

A drawing die for steel wire (A) of cylindrical shape (Z) having diameter of pellet d2 = 14 mm, diameter of case d3 - 28 mm, diameter of bearing dI = 3'5 mm, drawing angle 2a* = 16", case made of steel (St) and conformmg to this standard, shall be designated as: Die AZ 14 x 28 x 3'5 x 16" IS :4918-St When the case is made of brass (Bs) or bronze shall be replaced by `Bs' or `Bz' as appropriate. Example 2: (Bz), the letters `St' in the designation

A drawing die for non-ferrous metal bars (D), of conical shape (K) having diameter of pellet d2 = 25 mm, diameter of case d3 = 75 mm, diameter of bearing d, = 9 mm, radius of the generator circle of the toric surface, Rt, case made of steel (St) and conforming to this standard, shall be designated as: Die DK 25 x 75 X 9 x 99 x R IS: 4918-St When the case is made of brass (Bs) or bronze shall be replaced by `Bs' or `Bz' as appropriate.

Coating

and Packing paper name
